user.title: Select the LG TV
user.description: Select the TV already set up in the LG webOS TV integration. YouTube uses that connection, so the media player stays connected. Pair separately only for a TV that is not in that list.

manual.title: Pair a TV
manual.description: Use this only when the TV is not already set up in the LG webOS TV integration. The TV must be on. The MAC address is only used to wake it.

data_description.host: IP address or host name. A pasted address that includes a scheme is accepted.
data_description.mac: Optional. Needed for the power button to turn the TV on.

pairing.title: Pair with the TV
pairing.description: Submit, then accept the connection prompt on the TV. The prompt only stays up for a few seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the TV again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV rejected the saved key. Submit, then accept the new prompt on the TV.

reconfigure.title: Update the TV address
reconfigure.description: Use this when the TV gets a new IP address, or to add a MAC address for Wake-on-LAN. Leave the MAC blank to stop waking the TV.

reconfigure_link.title: Select the LG TV
reconfigure_link.description: Select the TV already set up in the LG webOS TV integration. YouTube keeps using that connection.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Turn the TV on and check the address.
error.error_pairing: Pairing was rejected or timed out. Accept the prompt on the TV, then try again.
error.invalid_host: Enter the TV's IP address or host name.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address like aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff.

abort.already_in_progress: This TV is already being configured.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered TV did not include an address.
abort.wrong_device: That address is a different TV.

init.title: YouTube launch
init.description: YouTube opens once. contentTarget is v= followed by the video id. A full leanback link makes the app load, then open and load again.

data.close_before_play: Close YouTube before opening a new video

data_description.close_before_play: Used only when YouTube is already on screen. webOS 4 ignores a new video until that app is closed. A cold start sends one launch and does not close anything.
data_description.launch_method: contentTarget sends v= and the video id, which starts the video once. contentId sends the 11-character id. The leanback contentId sends the tv address and can make the app load twice.
data_description.app_id: Detected at pairing. youtube.leanback.v4 is the app on webOS 4.10.

play.name: Play YouTube
play.description: Open a YouTube video or playlist on the LG TV.

url.name: YouTube URL
url.description: A youtube.com link, a youtu.be link, a shorts link, or an 11-character video id.
